summary: Iter45 re-verification of two iter44 fixes in EsignWizard.tsx — both PASS. (1) HIGH autosave-restore: fixed via `restored` state flag gating useAutosave. After Step 1 upload → Step 2 add 2nd signer → page reload, the wizard now resumes at Step 2 with both signers intact AND the 'Draft restored' toast fires. localStorage snapshot is preserved across reload (no longer clobbered by useAutosave mount write). (2) MEDIUM signer-0 prefill: fixed via new useEffect watching user+restored. Signer-row-0 on Step 2 is now prefilled with 'Admin' / 'admin@realprofits.com' on a fresh wizard load. Smoke nav back to Step 1 confirms title is preserved through restore.

verifications.smoke_after_restore_back_then_forward: EXPECTED-LIMITATION — After restore on Step 2, going Back to Step 1 leaves `file` state null (File objects can't survive localStorage), so wizard-next is disabled until the user re-uploads. This is a pre-existing design limit, not a regression from iter45. The docId is retained in the snapshot so re-upload is technically redundant but currently still gated by file presence.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor UX, pre-existing): After autosave-restore brings the user to Step 2+, going Back to Step 1 disables Continue because `file` is null. Either (a) skip the file requirement on Step 1 when a docId already exists in state, or (b) disable Back to Step 1 once Step 1 is considered complete (file uploaded server-side). Not blocking — the primary flow (reload → resume at saved step → Continue) works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Both iter44 fixes are minimal, correctly scoped, and verified working. The `restored` gate on useAutosave is the right pattern: it prevents the empty initial state from overwriting the saved snapshot before the restore effect reads it.
Minor: useMemo at line 524 of EsignWizard.tsx is still used purely for setActiveSignerId side-effect — should be useEffect. Pre-existing, flagged in iter43/44, still present.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iter44 fixes are fully verified. The autosave restore now works end-to-end: snapshot writes correctly, survives reload, restores step + title + signers, and fires the 'Draft restored' toast. Signer-0 backfill from useAuth() works on fresh page loads. Only remaining minor item is the Back-to-Step-1 dead-end after restore (file state can't persist in localStorage) — not a regression, optional polish.
rca_of_the_issue: Confirmed iter44 RCA was correct: useAutosave's debounce timer fired on initial mount with empty state and overwrote the saved snapshot before the restore useEffect could read it. iter45 fix gates `useAutosave({enabled: restored})` so no localStorage write happens until the mount-time restore effect either restores the saved snapshot (setRestored(true) after applying it) or confirms there's nothing meaningful to restore (setRestored(true) on cold start). Verified by inspecting localStorage immediately after reload — content identical to pre-reload, no clobbering observed.
